info.title: AutoCare API
info.description:
REST API for AutoCare, a vehicle maintenance manager.

Milestone 3 state: all CRUD endpoints, validation and the NHTSA external API integration. Authentication and role checks (JWT) are added in Milestone 4.

get.description: Calls the NHTSA Recalls API for the vehicle's make, model and year. If NHTSA is down or slow the API answers 503 with a friendly message and the rest of the application keeps working.
